messages:
alice.m: Heads up — SCIM provisioning started creating duplicate users for a customer (Trenchant). Suspect trailing whitespace in the IdP-sent email/nameID. Also seeing intermittent KMS decrypt failures when processing encrypted extId attrs
ben: Can you paste the raw SCIM payload (or a redacted snippet)?
alice.m: Sure, redacted payload:
```json
{
  "userName": "jane.doe@example.com ",  // note trailing space
  "externalId": "ext|12345 "
}
```
carol: We do trimming in the normalizer normally; looks like PR #452 toggled `preserve_whitespace=true` in the SCIM pipeline for legacy compatibility. @dmitri might have flipped it.
dmitri: Yep — flipped it during last week's enterprise rollout to satisfy a customer who relied on exact-match. I can revert, but need to coordinate migrations.
sean: About the KMS logs — paste the small stack trace so I can see if it's the known padding bug. We had HSM ops earlier.
alice.m: Pasted logs:
```
2026-03-20T01:05:12Z kms-client DecryptError: invalid padding (bad padding)
 at com.redwood.kms.Client.decrypt(Client.java:142)
 at com.redwood.scim.EnvelopeProcessor.unwrap(EnvelopeProcessor.java:78)
```
ops-bot: KMS maintenance completed: 2026-03-20T02:10Z (ticket INFRA-824)
ben: Repro steps I used:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/scim/v2/Users -d @payload.json
```
If payload contains trailing whitespace in userName/externalId we create a second record instead of merging.
carol: @alice.m can you run: `SELECT id, userName, externalId FROM scim_users WHERE externalId LIKE 'ext|12345%'` and paste results? I want to confirm dedupe key mismatch.
alice.m: Ran query, results show two rows: extid values differ only by trailing space. Also noticed RBAC audit for group mapping references the trimmed variant but our session mapping picked the untrimmed user => risk of incorrect access. Link to logs: https://internal.logs/trace/abcd123
dmitri: I'll revert the flag in staging and push a hotfix to the normalizer to always trim whitespace before dedupe. Will also add a migration to dedupe existing records by trimmed externalId. Opening PR 4825 now.
sean: KMS decrypt: looks like the Java client had a padding bug in 2.3.4 — bump to 2.4.1 fixes it. I'll roll the lib to staging and enable the graceful fallback decrypt path so provisioning doesn't drop on single decrypt errors.
carol: Can we canary the normalizer change on just the Trenchant customer? Also add an alert: SCIM decrypt_errors > 0 -> pager.
alice.m: Oncall @oncall please pause any RBAC rollouts until we finish triage — we don't want config flips to make the mismatch worse.
oncall: Acknowledged. Pausing RBAC rollouts. I'll run an emergency dedupe job to merge Trenchant's two accounts and preserve sessions.
dmitri: PR 4825 created with two commits: (1) set preserve_whitespace=false, (2) add trim() in SCIM normalizer. Migration script attached. Requesting infra deploy window.
sean: I'll schedule the KMS client bump and HSM validation in the 02:30Z deploy window to avoid another maintenance overlap. Also tracking CVE-2026-XXXXX for the java-kms client; it's low severity for our usage but will patch.
carol: Note for SOC/compliance: maintain full audit chain for the dedupe migration (90d retention). Ensure we link original SCIM request IDs in the migration log.
alice.m: Thanks everyone — I'll contact the Trenchant account team and draft a short incident email.
incident-bot: Incident #2026-03-20-01 opened: SSO/SCIM duplicate provisioning + KMS decrypt errors. Severity: P2. Incident lead: carol.
